title: VSx Glow
description: A Neovim-inspired dark theme blending One Dark Pro and Dracula Official. Developed by SGDEV.

title: Coflow: Code Map
description: See how your code runs: a zoomable map from the whole system down to every line of a function, with entry points, calls, web routes, code that never runs and replays of real runs. Supports Python today; more languages are coming.

title: Metafacture Flux
description: Language Support for Metafacture Flux. For more information, visit https://metafacture.org

title: Delphi Debugger
description: Debug Delphi Win32/Win64 applications in VS Code, outside the RAD Studio IDE; also an MCP server for AI agents

title: C# Auto Parens
description: Adds '()' when a method is accepted from the completion list, except when it is passed as a delegate, subscribed with +=/-= or used inside nameof().

title: C# Auto Suggest
description: Rider-like completion: opens the suggestion list as soon as a new identifier starts being typed.

title: C# Smart Semicolon
description: Rider-like smart semicolon: typing ';' inside parentheses moves it to the end of the line.

title: MarkupMe
description: Standards-first Markdown for VS Code: a live preview with Blueprint, Graphviz and Mermaid diagrams and syntax highlighting, HTML export, a table of contents, formatting and lint diagnostics.

title: Assessment Tool
description: A VS Code extension for timed technical assessments and workspace-based coding challenges, including candidate sessions and evaluation workflows.

title: Saffron Atelier
description: A warm cream & beige light theme with muted olive, soft blue and terracotta accents.

title: AGI-S
description: AGI-S in your editor: ask, explain, and edit code in place.
